clips.title: The story
paras: Kin'weelay is a renowned Darkspear witch doctor stationed at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. Dispatched directly from Orgrimmar, he offers mystical aid and counsel to the Horde vanguard in the jungle. His spiritual expertise is vital in unravelling dark mojo and aiding the rescue of young Yenniku.

Recognized among the Darkspear as one of their most powerful practitioners of traditional witchcraft, Kin'weelay commands deep knowledge of spirits, hexes, and soul magic. When matters involving ancestral spirits or hostile troll enchantments arise, Horde scouts in Stranglethorn Vale look to him to pierce the magical veil.
